ValidationRule.description: Sampling Rate is a percentage of visitors, so it must be between 0 and 100. Catches a fat-fingered value like 500 or -10 that would otherwise reach the wrapper as a nonsensical probability. Blank is allowed and means 100%.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sampling Rate must be between 0 and 100 (it is a percentage of visitors). Leave it blank to show the agent to 100% of visitors.
